subclassesOf.description: Every descendant of these classes, the classes themselves excluded.

hierarchyOf.description: Whole hierarchies of these classes, superclasses and subclasses alike, the classes themselves included.

superclassesOf.description: Every ancestor of these classes, the classes themselves excluded.

side.description: Which sides of the selected classes to sweep.

scope.description: What to narrow the sweep to. Give several entries and everything any of them selects is covered. Omitted, the whole image is swept.

protocol.description: Keep methods whose protocol contains this text. Case matters.

offset.description: Index of the first result to return. A page is a fixed size, which tool_get reports for this tool; a result that was cut short says how many more there are.

selector.description: Keep methods whose selector contains this text. Case matters, as it does in a selector.
